_comment: frequency_modulation/01_4tone_comb (2026-09-10): FREQUENCY-ENCODED reservoir input — the 05d production crystal (60 um, SGMA 1.86e-5, pump 100, no rate_32) driven by a 4-TONE COMB instead of 4 spatial strips: four co-located full-height CW Ey sources at f0+{-2,-1,+1,+2}x1e-4 (f0=1/1.064; 30-GHz spacing, total span 4e-4 < gammaE 5.3e-4 so all tones sit inside the gain line). No spatial separation -> slab shrunk to 6 um (cell_y 10). Amplitude 35/tone => mean total intensity ~ 4*35^2 = 70^2 = the 05d knee. The saturable gain mixes the tones -> intermodulation products at integer comb multiples; monitor_1/2 carry 61 frequency-LINEAR bins spaced exactly 1e-4 so tones and IMD land on exact bins (design01b_twotone lesson). TIMING: resolving 1e-4 spacing needs T_int >= 2/df -> window 4000-24000 (2 beat periods; freq resolution 5e-5). Backend gpumeep-compatible (plain continuous sources). Settling: <3000 at these powers (05d pilot), window starts 4000. pop_monitor REMOVED (2026-09-10): --empty drops the crystal and add_population_monitor then refuses (no gain medium); the comb measurement is spectral, populations not needed here.

crystal._comment: Nd:YAG gain, 05c-prime: crystal 60 um (mixing path + gain-length x3 vs 05b) but SGMA back to the known-good 1.86e-5 — 05c's SGMA x3 pulled the negative-population ceiling below drive 120, starved the pump crossing the slab (low-drive N3 only 0.64-0.76), and slowed settling (pump-depletion equilibrium). Emission+pump model, no rate_32.

monitor_1._comment: 61 DFT bins LINEAR IN FREQUENCY from f0-30e-4 to f0+30e-4, spacing exactly 1e-4 = the tone spacing, so all 4 tones (at ±1,±2 bins) AND every intermodulation product land exactly on bins.

monitor_2._comment: 61 DFT bins LINEAR IN FREQUENCY from f0-30e-4 to f0+30e-4, spacing exactly 1e-4 = the tone spacing, so all 4 tones (at ±1,±2 bins) AND every intermodulation product land exactly on bins.

snap_point._comment: output y-LINE time record (1Dsnap = line in y). The multi-strip output is y-dependent, so a single point misses the transverse profile; this records the whole output-guide y-line vs time. dt 20 (coarse on purpose) keeps storage modest for long/many runs — tune down toward the 1.064 carrier period (~1.06 t.u.) if you need the field phase rather than the envelope.

field_map._comment: full-cell |E|(x,y) at 1.064 over 300-600. Includes the source point — clip the colour scale when plotting (known full-domain-2Ddft gotcha).

source_pump._comment: 808 nm CW pump from above, Ez, whole 20-um crystal top edge. Amp 100 (the 'set pump so stationary comes quickly' knob, 2026-09-09): with no rate_32 the pump is the recharge and its rate sets how fast the inversion reaches steady state.
